result.reason: The operative language covers Company affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf, makes the royalty-free licence perpetual and irrevocable, and permits transfer in an M&A transaction, satisfying at least the fallback transfer position. No subscription issue arises because this is a perpetual licence. However, adding “worldwide” is not required by the playbook, so the revision is not strictly minimal. Drafting quality is reduced by the awkward parenthetical structure and the retained grammatical error “create, derivative version,” which should read “create derivative works.”
